$description: Real SAM.gov v2 API responses captured live on 2026-07-21 against https://api.sam.gov/opportunities/v2/search using the project's SAM_GOV_API_KEY. Public federal notice data — no PII beyond a government contracting officer's public business contact info. Resolves two open pre-mortem questions from 00-Brief.md.

resolved_unknowns.resourceLinks_filename: CONFIRMED: resourceLinks array entries are bare download URLs with no filename or label. The real filename is only available via the 'Content-Disposition' response header on the authenticated GET request (e.g. 'attachment; filename=Sol_140G0326Q0165.pdf'). sam_client.py must parse this header; fall back to a generated name (e.g. `attachment_{n}.bin`) if the header is absent.
resolved_unknowns.resourceLink_auth: CONFIRMED: api_key must be passed as a query param on the download GET itself (same as the search call) — HEAD requests return 403 (S3 presigned quirk), but GET with api_key returns 200 + the real file bytes. Worker must use GET, not HEAD, to validate/download.
resolved_unknowns.pointOfContact_shape: CONFIRMED: JSON array (not object) of {fax, type, email, phone, title, fullName}. Can be null (see Example 2 fixture below).
resolved_unknowns.placeOfPerformance_shape: CONFIRMED: JSON object {streetAddress, city: {code,name}, state: {code,name}, zip, country: {code,name}}. Can be present but with empty sub-objects ({} for city/state/country) when SAM.gov has no POP data yet — see real fixture below.
